pages.title: Comfort
pages.text: I've been on the run for too long. A home, if I set up a home, I'll be able to get some proper $(bold)rest$().$(br2)$(italics)$(#a84b0f)$()
pages.text2: $(italics)$(#a84b0f)Comfort is a mechanic that grants positive effecs and immunity to negative effects depending on its level.$()

pages.text: $(italics)$(#a84b0f)In order to trigger comfort, a home must have a roof, a light source, and a $(t:Showcased on the left page. Also include Fires, Heaters, or Stoves)$(thing)core.$()$(br2)$(italics)$(#a84b0f)Once those requirements are met, any items with the tooltip $(#b38a04)$(t:Can be searched in JEI. Tooltips will be more informative once at least Comfort I has been achieved)[Comfortable]$()$(#a84b0f) will contribute to increasing the level of comfort. With more valuable objects or concepts granting more comfort, up to a certain point.$()
